decisive_items: Some P waves do not conduct to ventricles
PR interval prolongs between first and second conducted beats
prolonged His-ventricular (HV) interval of 75 milliseconds on first conducted beat, extending to 277 milliseconds on second conducted beat
response.rationale: Infranodal AV block with dropped beats and marked HV prolongation specifically indicates Mobitz Type II, whereas right bundle branch block is an accompanying ECG finding and sick sinus syndrome does not explain the conduction failure below the His bundle.

rejected.why: Symptoms and bradycardia are nonspecific; AV block with non-conducted P waves is not a sinus node dysfunction.
Right bundle branch block is present but is a coexistent finding, not the primary diagnosis for the AV block.
